Key_Symptoms: No symptoms present

Key_Symptoms: Easy bruising, bleeding gums, slow wound healing, joint pain
Visible_Hair_Signs: Corkscrew-shaped curly hair shafts, perifollicular hemorrhage, coiled/fragmented hairs
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Scurvy symptoms: fatigue, swollen/bleeding gums, petechiae, poor wound healing

Key_Symptoms: Patchy hair loss, scalp redness, brittle nails, skin rash around eyes/nose/mouth
Visible_Hair_Signs: Patchy alopecia, thinning at crown, hair breakage
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Dermatitis, fatigue, numbness/tingling in extremities, depression
Risk_Factors: Raw egg white consumption (avidin), prolonged antibiotic/anticonvulsant use, pregnancy, biotinidase deficiency

Key_Symptoms: Generalized hair thinning, brittle nails, mild scalp irritation
Visible_Hair_Signs: Diffuse thinning, reduced hair shaft diameter, increased shedding
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Fatigue, mild skin rash, muscle pain

Key_Symptoms: Hair loss, delayed wound healing, altered taste/smell, skin lesions
Visible_Hair_Signs: Diffuse or patchy alopecia, scalp dryness, brittle hair texture
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Acrodermatitis enteropathica-like rash, diarrhea, impaired immunity, poor appetite

Key_Symptoms: Thin/sparse hair growth, dry skin, slow growth in children
Visible_Hair_Signs: Sparse hair density, thin hair shafts, dull appearance
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Growth retardation in children, delayed wound healing, frequent infections
Risk_Factors: Low dietary zinc intake, malabsorption, chronic illness, excessive sweating

Key_Symptoms: Diffuse hair shedding, fatigue, pale skin, shortness of breath
Visible_Hair_Signs: Diffuse non-patchy hair loss, increased telogen hair shedding, thinning part line
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Fatigue, pallor, dizziness, brittle nails (koilonychia), restless legs
Risk_Factors: Heavy menstrual bleeding, poor dietary iron intake, pregnancy, chronic blood loss, GI disorders

Key_Symptoms: Gradual hair thinning, fatigue, reduced exercise tolerance
Visible_Hair_Signs: Overall hair thinning, reduced hair volume, increased shedding during combing/washing
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Fatigue, pale conjunctiva, brittle nails, cold intolerance
Risk_Factors: Low ferritin levels, menstruating women, vegetarian/vegan diet, frequent blood donation

Key_Symptoms: Sparse hair growth, muscle wasting, edema, growth failure in children
Visible_Hair_Signs: Sparse, thin hair distribution, reduced hair density across scalp
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Edema, muscle wasting, growth retardation, lethargy, immune suppression
Risk_Factors: Severe caloric/protein restriction, chronic illness, poverty, eating disorders

Key_Symptoms: Thin, weak hair strands, fatigue, poor growth
Visible_Hair_Signs: Thin hair shafts, reduced hair strength, increased breakage
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Weight loss, muscle wasting, weakness, delayed development in children
Risk_Factors: Chronic undernutrition, restrictive diets, malabsorption, poverty

Key_Symptoms: Brittle, easily breakable hair, fatigue, poor skin condition
Visible_Hair_Signs: Brittle, dry hair shafts prone to snapping, rough texture
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Edema, muscle wasting, lethargy, poor wound healing
Risk_Factors: Severe dietary protein restriction, chronic disease, poverty, malabsorption

Key_Symptoms: Loss of natural hair color, banding pattern (flag sign), fatigue
Visible_Hair_Signs: Depigmented or reddish-brown discoloration of hair, alternating light/dark bands (flag sign)
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Severe malnutrition signs, edema (kwashiorkor), growth failure, skin changes
Risk_Factors: Severe/chronic protein deficiency, kwashiorkor, poverty, famine conditions

Key_Symptoms: Diffuse hair loss or shedding, bone/muscle pain, fatigue
Visible_Hair_Signs: Diffuse thinning, increased telogen effluvium-type shedding
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Bone pain, muscle weakness, fatigue, low mood, frequent infections
Risk_Factors: Limited sun exposure, darker skin tone, obesity, malabsorption, older age, autoimmune conditions (alopecia areata link)

Key_Symptoms: Hair thinning/loss, dry skin, night vision problems
Visible_Hair_Signs: Diffuse hair loss, dry brittle hair strands
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Night blindness, dry skin (phrynoderma), reduced immunity
Risk_Factors: Vitamin A deficient diet, malabsorption, liver disease, excessive supplementation can also cause loss (hypervitaminosis A)

Key_Symptoms: Dry, dull hair texture, dry skin, scalp flaking
Visible_Hair_Signs: Dry, lusterless hair shafts, flaky scalp, reduced sebum production
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Dry skin, night blindness, follicular hyperkeratosis
Risk_Factors: Chronic Vitamin A deficient diet, fat malabsorption disorders

Key_Symptoms: Gradual hair thinning in a patterned distribution, receding hairline (men), widening part (women)
Visible_Hair_Signs: Miniaturized hair follicles, patterned thinning (vertex/temples in men, crown in women)
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Family history of pattern baldness, hormonal changes
Risk_Factors: Genetics, age, androgen sensitivity, family history

Key_Symptoms: Sudden patchy hair loss, smooth bald patches, occasional nail pitting
Visible_Hair_Signs: Well-circumscribed round/oval bald patches, exclamation-mark hairs at patch borders
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Possible association with other autoimmune conditions (thyroid disease, vitiligo)
Risk_Factors: Autoimmune predisposition, family history, stress, co-existing autoimmune disorders

Key_Symptoms: Diffuse hair shedding 2-3 months after a triggering event, increased hair in brush/drain
Visible_Hair_Signs: Diffuse thinning without patches, increased telogen (resting phase) hair ratio
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: History of recent illness, surgery, childbirth, major stress, high fever, crash dieting
Risk_Factors: Major physical/emotional stress, postpartum state, surgery, severe illness, rapid weight loss

Key_Symptoms: Hair loss at hairline/temples, scalp tenderness, small bumps at follicles
Visible_Hair_Signs: Thinning/loss along hairline or areas of tension, broken hairs of varying length
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Scalp soreness from tight hairstyles
Risk_Factors: Tight hairstyles (braids, ponytails, weaves, extensions), prolonged tension on hair

Key_Symptoms: Irregular patches of hair loss, urge to pull hair, hairs of varying length in patches
Visible_Hair_Signs: Irregular, patchy hair loss with broken hairs of differing lengths, unusual patch shapes
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Associated anxiety, stress, obsessive-compulsive tendencies
Risk_Factors: Psychological stress, anxiety disorders, OCD spectrum conditions

Key_Symptoms: Itchy scalp, scaling, patchy hair loss, possible pus-filled sores
Visible_Hair_Signs: Scaly patches with broken hairs at scalp surface (black dot pattern), possible kerion (boggy swelling)
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Scalp itching, lymphadenopathy in severe cases
Risk_Factors: Close contact with infected individuals/animals, shared combs/hats, poor hygiene, warm humid climates

Key_Symptoms: Permanent hair loss, scalp burning/itching, visible scarring
Visible_Hair_Signs: Loss of visible follicular openings, smooth scarred patches, possible redness/scaling at active margins
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Scalp pain, itching, burning sensation in active disease
Risk_Factors: Autoimmune conditions (lichen planopilaris, discoid lupus), untreated infections, chronic inflammation

Key_Symptoms: Scalp itching, flaking/dandruff, oily scaling patches
Visible_Hair_Signs: Yellowish greasy scales, erythema, mild diffuse thinning in chronic cases
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Seborrhea on other body areas (face, chest), occasional association with neurological conditions
Risk_Factors: Malassezia yeast overgrowth, oily skin, stress, cold weather, immunosuppression

Key_Symptoms: Scalp itching, thick silvery scales, occasional hair thinning in affected areas
Visible_Hair_Signs: Well-demarcated red plaques with thick silvery-white scale, possible temporary hair loss in plaque areas
Common_Systemic_Symptoms: Joint pain (psoriatic arthritis), skin plaques elsewhere on body
Risk_Factors: Genetic predisposition, immune dysregulation, stress, skin trauma (Koebner phenomenon)

Common_Systemic_Symptoms: May overlap with nutritional deficiency or indicate genetic hair shaft disorder
Risk_Factors: Genetic hair shaft disorders, nutritional deficiency, excessive chemical/heat damage
